title: cyathocalyx deltoideus
intro: Cyathocalyx deltoideus, commonly known as the Philippine caterpillar tree, is a species of plant in the family Annonaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and wounds, likely due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Cyathocalyx deltoideus include annonaceous acetogenins, which are compounds with potential anticancer and antiparasitic activities. However, more research is needed to fully understand the efficacy and potential benefits of this plant.
